The most prominent feature is a long, orange-colored bar located at the bottom front of the keyboard area, serving as the space bar or wrist rest. The image is a close-up, slightly high-angle shot against a plain light blue background.

The geometry of the paper roller and carriage return lever at the top is slightly warped and inconsistent with rigid mechanical engineering standards. The lines do not converge perfectly.
